protectedFeatureCheck.coordinates: Pixel centers in the inverse per-pose faceTransform axes about each registered featureGuide.
protectedFeatureCheck.limitations: Guides are inferred authoring annotations, not anatomical segmentation. Exact original pixels are asserted throughout these conservative regions; the remaining eye/nose boundary and visual seams require native-size visual review.

blurredVisualReview.note: Native crops of original source and the shipped Joyful bank composited over that same source; no hairstyle/context substitution.

banks.naturalAndGentleProof: Source bytes, pose/foreground/padding metadata, original style mappings and all original PNG bytes remain exact; unchanged compositor therefore receives identical inputs.
